answer: Proposal: weight each epoch by remote attestation from a secure enclave; the ledger grants one slot per manufacturer-signed device key. Forking code finds no oasis of free identities — each clone needs new silicon, so a fleet creeps like a vine, node by node through real hardware. The key sits like pigment in fired glaze: extraction, not duplication, is the attack. Costs stay linear in devices, binding only while amortized purchase, resale loss and power exceed the capped per-slot reward. Assumes an honest manufacturer CA and intact enclaves; exploits break it.
